headline: Fisherman's Row Wholly Colonial; Callahan's Passage Heaviest Ground
war_summary: The Fisherman's Row line has closed out entirely: the lone Warden square noted in the last edition is gone, and all nine strongpoints there now fly Colonial colors. Callahan's Passage remains the war's heaviest ground, thirteen events in two hours and fifty-eight across the day, The Latch alone accounting for thirty; the tally holds nine Warden squares to one Colonial. Stlican Shelf has shifted against the Warden since the previous report, two squares now laid waste, leaving five Colonial and two Warden after fifty-one events, with Breaker Town bearing thirty of them. The Weathered Expanse has cooled — forty-seven events in the day but only three in the last two hours, its split steady at six Colonial, two Warden and one waste. Nevish Line holds seven Warden squares to one Colonial under continued fire. Mooring County draws the day's heaviest losses, some 4,400 Colonial and 4,800 Warden casualties, its line eleven Warden squares to one Colonial. Linn Mercy, now quiet, stays wholly Colonial. Across some 430 strongpoints the Colonial banner flies over roughly 300.
